items.title: MPs push to bring Northern Ireland claims firms under FCA rules
items.summary: An amendment to the Financial Services and Markets Bill seeks to extend FCA oversight to claims management companies in Northern Ireland.

items.title: AXA XL appoints Rebecca Cole deputy head of UK and Lloyd’s equine, livestock and aquaculture
items.summary: AXA XL has promoted Rebecca Cole to deputy head of its UK and Lloyd’s equine, livestock and aquaculture business alongside other team changes.

items.title: Nationwide launches 1% deposit mortgage allowing borrowing up to six times income
items.summary: Nationwide has introduced a 5.99% fixed-rate mortgage requiring a 1% deposit, prompting warnings from brokers over potential negative equity.

items.title: Tara Foley departs AXA UK and Ireland with Jon Walker named interim CEO
items.summary: AXA UK and Ireland chief executive Tara Foley is leaving the group after six years, with general insurance head Jon Walker stepping in as interim CEO.

items.title: BIBA welcomes proposed FCA regulation for Northern Ireland claims firms
items.summary: A cross-party group of MPs has tabled an amendment to bring claims management companies in Northern Ireland under FCA supervision.

items.title: HM Treasury details £100 household energy payments starting January 2027
items.summary: HM Treasury has published operational guidance for a one-off £100 energy payment for over 20 million English households in council tax bands A to D.
